lines.text: She, not he, for a woman!
Many learners say: My sister is a nurse. He works hard.
Better: My sister is a nurse. She works hard.
She! My mother is kind. She helps me.

data.wrong: My sister is a nurse. He works hard.
data.right: My sister is a nurse. She works hard.

quiz.stem: My mother is kind. ___ helps me.

native.hook: ผู้หญิงใช้ she ไม่ใช่ he!
native.tip: ไทยใช้ “เขา” ได้ทั้งชายหญิง แต่อังกฤษแยก he กับ she
native.caption: คุณเคยพูดว่า “My sister is a nurse. He works hard.” ไหม? 😅 ภาษาไทยใช้ “เขา” ได้ทั้งผู้ชายและผู้หญิง แต่ภาษาอังกฤษแยก he กับ she ผู้หญิงต้องใช้ she: “My sister is a nurse. She works hard.” ฟังครู Ama แล้วพูดตามนะ! ฝึกเพิ่มในแอป Lexkite

en.tip: Thai uses one word for he and she, but English has both: “She works hard”
en.caption: Do you say “My sister is a nurse. He works hard”? 😅 Thai uses one word for both men and women, but English separates he and she. Say “My sister is a nurse. She works hard”! Listen to Ama and repeat! Practice more in the Lexkite app.
